sourceRecord.title: UCEED 2026 · Mini Mock 01
sourceRecord.instructions: Short practice set using 15 selected questions from the supplied official UCEED 2026 Part A paper; these are not new questions. Practice duration: 32 minutes (shortened for this mock, not the official exam duration). 4 NAT + 4 MSQ + 7 MCQ; maximum 53 marks. NAT: +4 correct, 0 incorrect or blank. MSQ: +4 for an accepted complete answer; +3 for three correct choices when all four are correct; +2 for two correct choices when at least three are correct; +1 for one correct choice when at least two are correct. Partial credit requires no incorrect selection. Other answered MSQs: -1; blank: 0. MCQ: +3 correct, -0.71 incorrect, 0 blank. All sections share one timer. Part B drawing is not included.
